				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = 12.5 tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
			}
		}
		unlock_decision_tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_reduce_political
		unlock_decision_tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_restore_political
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate
		COLDWAR_AP_reduce_political = yes
		} }
